_meta.description: Eval set for RAG Document Q&A Bot, Step 8. Ground truth = source_url. Used by Step 9's Recall@k harness (retrieval-only, no LLM calls).

categories.neutral: Built independently of chunker-specific findings from Step 7, to avoid biasing toward whichever strategy already looked good under manual inspection.
categories.adversarial: Deliberately targets known limitations #2, #5, #6 (retrieval-layer only) documented in qabotproject.md. Excludes limitations #1, #3, #4, #7 which are generation-layer, condenser-specific, or metadata-only and cannot be scored by a source_url-in-top-k check -- see generation_spotchecks.md for #1 and #4.
categories.out_of_corpus: Excluded from Recall@k aggregation (source_urls is empty, there is no correct chunk to find). Kept for manual generation-layer refusal spot-checks.

match_type.any: Multiple plausible source_urls; a hit on any one counts as retrieved.
match_type.all: Multiple source_urls; every one must appear in top-k to count as a full hit.
match_type.null: No correct source_url exists (out_of_corpus category) -- excluded from scoring.

known_ground_truth_limitation.reason: opintotukiaika_korkeakoulussa.md and tulojen_vaikutus_korkeakoulussa.md each hold all their cohort/year variants under one shared source_url. Recall@k can only confirm doc-level retrieval, not that the specific correct cohort/year chunk was retrieved -- that requires manual chunk-level inspection.

questions.question: Mitä tukia korkeakouluopiskelija voi saada Kelalta?
Kuinka paljon opintorahaa voi saada kuukaudessa?
Miten opintolainan valtiontakaus haetaan?
Kuinka monta tukikuukautta saa korkeakoulututkintoon?
Saanko opintotukea, jos opiskelen kahta tutkintoa samaan aikaan?
Voiko opintotukiaikaa pidentää sairauden takia?
questions.notes: Originally single-URL; changed to any after Step 9 found all 3 chunking strategies independently ranked sairastaminen-korkeakoulussa first, not the original ground truth. Both docs legitimately answer this question -- sairastaminen explains the sick-leave-extends-things concept, opintotukiajan-pidennys covers the application procedure. Cross-strategy agreement (rank 1 identical across all three) was the signal this was a ground-truth issue, not a retrieval bug.

questions.question: Kuinka monta opintopistettä pitää suorittaa vuodessa, ettei opintotukea peritä takaisin?
Paljonko saa ansaita opintotuen aikana ilman että se vaikuttaa tukeen?
questions.notes: Neutral phrasing of the income-limit question. Contrast with q030 (adversarial) which omits the support-month parameter deliberately.

questions.question: Vaikuttaako vanhempieni tulot opintorahaani, jos asun yksin?

Kuinka paljon ateriatuki alentaa opiskelijaruokailun hintaa?
Kuinka paljon asumislisää voi saada kuukaudessa?
questions.notes: Swapped from an earlier draft that accidentally matched the parent-rental adversarial case (limitation #5) too closely; that phrasing moved to q031.

questions.question: Pitääkö Kelalle ilmoittaa, jos muutan toiseen kaupunkiin kesken lukukauden?

questions.notes: Second question on tulojen_vaikutus -- doc has enough distinct content (annual limit rule, near-duplicate year tables) to warrant more than one neutral question.

questions.notes: Second question on opintotukiaika -- degree-size axis, distinct from the cohort-date axis tested elsewhere.

questions.question: Kuinka monta tukikuukautta saan, jos aloitin opintoni syksyllä 2020?
questions.notes: Targets limitation #2 -- cohort-date reasoning. Correct chunk ranked 10th under fixed_v1 in prior testing (outside default k=5), a structural limitation of pure vector search for date-range logic. Worth checking against semantic_v1/structure_v1.

questions.question: Voinko saada asumislisää, jos vuokraan asunnon vanhemmiltani?
questions.notes: Targets limitation #5 -- semantic_v1 splits the 83e/kk parent-rental rule from its qualifying condition (needs an actual lease agreement; zero allowance if parents live in the same apartment). A retrieved chunk under semantic_v1 may state the number confidently without its own precondition.

questions.question: Jos aloitin opintoni 1.8.2015 ja suoritan sekä alempaa (180 op) että ylempää (120 op) korkeakoulututkintoa, kuinka monta tukikuukautta minulla on yhteensä käytössä?
questions.notes: Targets limitation #6 -- mirrors the Aleksi worked example verbatim (1.8.2015 start, 180op+120op, 50kk total). structure_v1's max_chars fallback is documented to cut through worked examples in this section when the parent header-grouped section grows too large.

questions.question: Mikä oli tulojen yläraja opintotuessa vuonna 2023?
questions.notes: Targets the near-duplicate income-limit table hard case (2023/24 vs 2025/26 tables). Tests whether retrieval discriminates the correct year's table rather than the more recent/prominent one.

questions.question: Voitko laskea, paljonko opintotukea saisin, jos tienaan 800 euroa kuukaudessa?
questions.notes: Interactive calculator functionality, explicitly deferred per qabotproject.md scope decisions (would need function-calling, not retrieval). Excluded from Recall@k; manual refusal spot-check.

questions.question: Miten haen yleistä asumistukea, jos en ole opiskelija?
questions.notes: Yleinen asumistuki (general housing allowance, non-student) is referenced as an alternative in several docs (e.g. opintotuki_asumislisa.md) but its own eligibility/application process is never detailed in the corpus -- plausible false-positive bait via lexical overlap with asumislisa content.

questions.question: How do I apply for unemployment benefit after graduating?
questions.notes: Different Kela benefit entirely, not covered in this opintotuki-scoped corpus.

questions.question: Miten haen lapsilisää lapselleni?
questions.notes: Child benefit (lapsilisa) -- different Kela benefit domain entirely, zero corpus overlap.

questions.question: What is Kela's basic unemployment allowance amount per month?
questions.notes: Deliberate false-positive bait: 'paivaraha' (allowance/benefit) appears in-corpus for sick leave (sairauspäiväraha), so this tests whether retrieval is fooled by lexical proximity into pulling an unrelated benefit's chunk.
